policy.molecular_descriptors: PubChem computed properties of the active covalent additive moiety, excluding separate counterions. Carbon count is total carbon atoms of that moiety, not hydrophobic-tail length. Molecular weight remains the dosed compound/formula-unit mass (including counterions), or nominal average polymer mass.
policy.logp: PubChem XLogP3 / XLogP3-AA estimate for the specified charged or neutral moiety, NOT an experimental logD or a measured formulation partition coefficient.
policy.polymer: F127 carbon/HBA/TPSA values are nominal-chain estimates, not measured or batch-exact values. Two OH termini give HBD=2.
policy.hlb: additive_hlb is a mixed-source empirical descriptor: use the literature values reported by Bubli et al. (2025), Table 1, for CTAB, CHAPS and F127; retain the documented Davies calculations for SDS and representative Span-85. Preserve each value's method and source; these are not all Davies calculations or a uniformly measured scale. Urea remains null because no supported HLB value is established.
policy.hofmeister: Fixed, externally sourced ordinal convention; rank spacing and anion-minus-cation difference are engineered features, not measured thermodynamic quantities. No experimental LCST labels were used to construct ranks.
policy.mass_rounding: Retain existing formula-unit masses used by ingestion; verified against supplier values or PubChem within reporting precision. Do not change experimental concentrations for database rounding differences.
policy.unchanged: Workbook parsing, targets, master rows, and MoLFormer structures/PCA scores are unchanged by this lookup correction.

pubchem_additives.method: PUG REST computed-property snapshot; XLogP3, Cactvs TPSA/HBD/HBA, formal charge and formula. Per-compound records below.

pubchem_salts.method: PUG REST molecular formula, mass and net charge snapshot. Ionic charges/stoichiometry follow the registered formula units.

f127_supplier.method: Approximate molecular weight 12600; technical support confirms two hydroxyl end groups. Supplier also lists A=101/B=56, illustrating that nominal repeat counts are not batch-exact.

f127_chain.method: Original SDS/Pluronic study identifies F127 as EO100-PO65-EO100.

f127_chain_and_mass.method: Nominal EO100-PO65-EO100; manufacturer average mass 12600 and manufacturer HLB 22.

ertl.method: TPSA is an atom-fragment sum: ordinary ether O=9.23 A^2, alcohol OH=20.23 A^2. F127 application is a structural descriptor extrapolation, not a validated polymer surface/transport measurement.

davies.method: HLB=7+hydrophilic contributions-0.475 per CH/CH2/CH3/=CH. Table III supplies sorbitan ester 6.8, sorbitan OH 0.5, ether 1.3, and sodium sulfate headgroup 38.7. Footnote warns against extrapolating EO increments to about 200 EO residues.

span_vendor.method: Empirical/vendor HLB 1.8; commercial fatty-acid mixture, not a pure-isomer batch measurement.

surfactant_paper.locator: Table 1: Summary of surfactant properties, HLB column; Methods: Preparation of surfactants and salt solutions
surfactant_paper.method: Table 1 reports SDS 40, CTAB 21.4, Pluronic F127 22 and CHAPS 25.6. Methods explicitly identifies SDS as Davies-calculated and the other three as commonly reported literature values. Adopt the reported literature values without relabeling them as Davies calculations.

ion_cations_and_phosphate.method: Original study documents sulfate/HPO4/chloride/bromide/nitrate ordering and the reverse cation order Ca>Mg>Li>Na>=K>NH4; also explains system-dependent inversions. The project's cation convention indexes NH4 to Ca.

ion_iodide.method: Original hydrogel study lists Cl>Br>NO3>I>ClO4>SCN in the standard anion sequence; supports inserting iodide at the existing project's vacant rank 7 (perchlorate is not part of that selected subseries).

ion_thiosulfate.method: A published expanded crystallization ranking includes thiosulfate, but does not give a commensurate numeric value on this project's selected scale. The phosphate nomenclature in this list is not an unambiguous formula-resolved mapping.

hlb.locator: Table 1, CHAPS row, HLB column (paper reference 10); Methods: Preparation of surfactants and salt solutions
hlb.reason: Adopt the literature HLB 25.6 reported by Bubli et al. This is not a reconstruction of the unsupported old Davies group sum 18.375.

hlb.locator: Table 1, CTAB row, HLB column (paper reference 10); Methods: Preparation of surfactants and salt solutions
hlb.reason: Adopt the literature HLB 21.4 reported by Bubli et al. This does not reuse the old 7.375 calculation, which assigned a tertiary-amine coefficient to quaternary ammonium.

nominal_chain.reason: Published representative composition consistent with nominal 12600 g/mol and ~70% PEO; actual commercial chain-length distribution is unknown.

additive_logp.reason: No verified whole-F127 logP with a comparable molecular definition was found. A small-oligomer proxy or an unvalidated long-chain XLogP extrapolation is not inserted.

hlb.locator: Table 1, Pluronic (F127) row, HLB column (paper references 23 and 72); Methods: Preparation of surfactants and salt solutions
hlb.reason: Adopt the literature HLB 22 reported for F127 by Bubli et al., also consistent with the manufacturer value recorded in the micelle study. This is not the old small-proxy Davies value 10.075 or a batch-exact polymer measurement.

Pluronic F127.embedding_limitation: Existing MoLFormer input remains the C7H16O4 oligomer proxy CC(COCCO)OCCO (CID 10154203), not this nominal full chain. It was not regenerated or silently reinterpreted; changing the embedding representation remains a separate unresolved modeling choice.

hlb.reason: Nominal sorbitan trioleate with three sorbitan ester groups and 57 non-carbonyl carbons. Davies assigns the same lipophilic coefficient to CH and CH2; check against sorbitan tristearate 2.1 in Table II. Not a measurement of the commercial isomer/fatty-acid mixture.
Urea is a small neutral chaotrope rather than a conventional amphiphile. No supported complete Davies group parameterization was established for its coupled urea functionality. Missing is not zero.

hofmeister.convention: Preserve the existing selected-subseries indices; fill only the vacant iodide position. F- and Li+ specify the existing intermediate slots but are not dataset salts. Equal integer spacing is a modeling convention, not physical distance.

S2O3_2-.reason: Thiosulfate is present in published qualitative rankings, but no unique position relative to HPO4_2- on this retained scale was established. Do not confuse H2PO4- (in the expanded hydrogel series) with HPO4_2- (in the workbook). Filling this requires choosing/documenting an extended rank convention; numeric zero or an arbitrary interpolated rank is not a sourced property.
